title: The Footbridge
summary: A runaway trolley will kill five people unless it is stopped. You are on a footbridge over the track, next to a very large man. If you push him off, his body will stop the trolley: he dies, the five live. You are too light to do it yourself. Judith Jarvis Thomson introduced the case to show that the numbers alone can't explain our reactions: most people would divert the trolley in the ordinary case, but won't push. One common explanation is the difference between harming someone as a side effect and using them as a means.
